description: This file declares functions related to gathering and processing network interface statistics on Linux systems. It includes function prototypes for retrieving interface, VAP, radio, and VLAN statistics from the Linux kernel or system interfaces.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getInterfaceStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific network interface identified by its name.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getVapStats
methods.description: Retrieves Virtual Access Point (VAP) statistics associated with a given access point.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllVapStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics for all VAPs associated with a specific radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllEpStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for all endpoints associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_acculumateUpperVlansStats
methods.description: Aggregates statistics for upper VLANs on a specified interface.
